title: just-deliver catalog part
description: Nodes and the exports evaluated from them: the shape components, runtimes and shared resources share (docs/architecture/documents.md section 2, concept 3). Not a document kind: the catalog kinds refer to its definitions.

nodes.description: Graph nodes by name; the name is how other expressions refer to the node, and part of graph node ids and backend stack names.

additionalProperties.description: Any name the pattern does not match: refused with this message (the validator ignores propertyNames).

x-jd.message: not a valid node name; use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending in a hyphen.

template.description: Template reference, relative to the catalog's templates directory.

kind.description: create (default) or grant. Grants are surfaced in the approval diff.

config.description: Template configuration. Values are any YAML scalar or map, kept as written.

layer.$comment: The listed order is the deploy order: shared before environment (documents.md Appendix B, role layer).
layer.description: A `jd env up` layer: `shared` is deployed once by the shared layer, `environment` once per environment.
